verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents the full end-to-end agentic checkout loop: buyer agent auto-created with pre-funded wallet, MCP server tools to discover sellers and create kya/pay/kya-pay tokens (delegated payment credentials), and seller-side charge-token API to collect payment and settle funds, with committed-amount guarantees and confirmed settlement timing. Runtime probes confirm the token API is live and key-gated as documented. missing for 10: independent third-party/hands-on confirmation of an actual completed purchase (all evidence is vendor docs/probes, no external case study or real transaction log), and no public OpenAPI spec found.
